decision.discovery: Accept 100 only after applying Erikson current-operation correction; operating institute retained on narrower current service basis.
decision.selection: Accept unchanged 25 as a side-by-side research-priority shortlist, not expected-value ranking or donor endorsement.

coverage.description: Every record received an independent current primary-lead retrieval and focused identity/service review. This is a discovery audit, not a complete verification of every source, EIN, donation checkout, annual output, county service share, or causal hypothesis. Three blocked records were checked through independently reopened primary indexed pages; targeted supplemental checks cover material recipient/closure issues.

before.geographyEvidence: Erikson current child/family clinic and practitioner program pages resolve403 and show Chicago clinical activity. Whole graduate institute, not clinic-only recipient.
before.mechanism: Young-child clinical assessment/therapy may reduce developmental distress.

after.geographyEvidence: Erikson’s Center for Children and Families closed all locations effective June 30, 2025. The current Fussy Baby Network Chicago offers infant-specialist phone support and describes home visits; its international warmline reach must not be counted wholly inside the Chicago MSA. Retain the whole operating institute, not the closed clinic, as the recipient.
after.independentFinding: The dedicated CCF closure notice overrides the stale general community-services page. Current Fussy Baby Network activity supports a narrower infant-family support hypothesis; no current CCF clinical intake or treatment output is credited.
after.mechanism: Infant-specialist support may reduce parental distress and improve caregiving; professional training may improve downstream services. These are hypotheses, not continued CCF assessment or therapy delivery.
after.falsifier: The closed CCF cannot deliver additional treatment. Remaining support or practitioner training may have no incremental durable health benefit, and broad institute costs or non-MSA reach may dominate.
after.einStatus: Observed on current primary Fussy Baby Network footer; not full tax-registry audit

requiredPatches.selectionEffect: Keep unselected. Update its alternative description and cohort reasoning to mention the clinical closure and narrower support/training hypothesis.

requiredPatches.after: Recipient identity is current; closed hosted campaign contains historical mail instructions only. Current donor checkout and mail fulfillment readiness remain unverified.
requiredPatches.reason: A closed campaign is not evidence that its mail address remains current.
